summary.summary: Raven called Jim back to confirm scheduling constraints for starting his roof installation. Raven asked if there were any days in the next few weeks that would not work; Jim clarified he was thinking in a 4–6 week window and said there were no conflicts. Jim mentioned they had considered taking a vacation but may postpone it until the roofing work is completed. Raven confirmed she would update the notes and thanked him, and the call ended with mutual thanks.
key_points: Customer rep (Raven) asked Jim if there were any days in the next couple of weeks that would not work for starting the roof installation.
Jim clarified the timeframe as 4 to 6 weeks and said there should be no scheduling conflicts.
Jim said they were thinking of taking a vacation but might postpone it until after the roof work is completed; Raven said she would update that information.
